description: Pages when a camera's HKSV recording-error rate stays over threshold for 20 min. sensor.camera_flap_rate v2 counts per-camera 'motion recording error' lines - a lost or truncated security clip - plus fleet-wide stream faults. It REPLACED a v1 metric that counted prebuffer restarts, a string that stopped occurring when prebuffer was disabled fleet-wide, leaving the sensor pinned at 0.0 and unable to fire for 9 days. Threshold 2/hr with a 3-event floor: a healthy camera records 0. Error-coded closes are context only - code 3 also covers a benign max-duration cancel.

data.title: 📹 Camera stream churn
